title: Donut with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='dough' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F5C46B'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#E8A940'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C8862A'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='frost' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF8FB8'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#F05D91'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C94070'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- donut body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='url(#dough)'/>
  <!-- frosting -->
  <path d='M50 12 C70 12 88 28 88 50 C88 56 86 62 82 68 C78 60 72 58 68 62 C62 68 58 64 54 66 C50 68 46 64 42 66 C38 68 34 64 30 60 C26 56 22 58 18 64 C14 58 12 54 12 50 C12 28 30 12 50 12 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <!-- drips -->
  <path d='M24 62 Q22 72 26 74 Q30 76 31 68 Z' fill='#F05D91'/>
  <path d='M44 66 Q43 76 47 78 Q51 80 51 70 Z' fill='#F05D91'/>
  <path d='M64 64 Q64 74 68 76 Q72 78 72 68 Z' fill='#F05D91'/>

  <rect x='30' y='26' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE14D' transform='rotate(-25 34 28)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='20' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#5BD1FF' transform='rotate(15 48 22)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='24' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#9BFF6E' transform='rotate(-15 64 26)'/>
  <rect x='70' y='34' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE14D' transform='rotate(40 74 36)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='40' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#C98BFF' transform='rotate(30 28 42)'/>
  <rect x='36' y='42' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#FF8A5B' transform='rotate(-35 40 44)'/>
  <rect x='64' y='46' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#5BD1FF' transform='rotate(-20 68 48)'/>
  <rect x='50' y='32' width='8' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#FF8A5B' transform='rotate(55 54 34)'/>
  <!-- hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='13' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#5A4228' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='3.2' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='3.2' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='43' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='43' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB3C9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB3C9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 56 Q50 66 60 56' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
